name: bamboo-sup-simulator
description: Hydrostatics and geometry for the bamboo SUP. Physics is headless and must not import Three.js.

scripts.build:site: vite build --config vite.hut-mobile.config.ts && vite build --config vite.models.config.ts --outDir ../out/site/models --emptyOutDir false && vite build --config vite.hut.config.ts --outDir ../out/site/sim/hut --emptyOutDir false && vite build --config vite.exploded.config.ts --outDir ../out/site/sim/raft --emptyOutDir false && vite build --config vite.sup.config.ts --outDir ../out/site/sim/sup --emptyOutDir false && node scripts/site-redirects.mjs out/site
